comment_en: Command Library — the maintained catalog behind the Guided Command Palette (§6B / roadmap §5). Backing values are CONTRACTS the palette dispatches BY NAME (no arbitrary execution). The palette NEVER bypasses a gate: read-only commands run; ROLLOUT-GATED critical commands are previewed/DRY only in the menu (real execution requires explicit Gev approval + flags outside the menu). Bilingual per L0.
comment_hy: Command Library — Guided Command Palette-ի հետևի catalog (§6B / roadmap §5)։ backing = contract, palette-ը dispatch է ըստ անվան (ոչ arbitrary execution)։ Palette-ը ԵՐԲԵՔ gate չի bypass անում՝ read-only-ները run, ROLLOUT-GATED critical-ները menu-ում preview/DRY (real = explicit Gev approval + flags menu-ից դուրս)։ Երկլեզու՝ L0։
availability_legend: CLEAN-BUILD = live read-only since the clean build | PHASE-N = live since that phase (all phases shipped, so live now) | LIVE = read-only, live now, operates on an INSTALLED project | ROLLOUT-GATED = critical, live, real execution needs -Execute + -Yes + BRO_GEV_APPROVED=1; the palette previews/DRY only | RUNTIME = finished-SuperBro command | FUTURE = designed, default OFF, opens only by explicit Gev command
